description: Q10 retrieval-gate calibration set. Neutral domains unrelated to ALFWorld (household object manipulation), OfficeQA (Treasury bulletin tables) and DocVQA (scanned documents). Each skill is rendered as its retrieval text (name, triggers one per line, description) exactly like skill_retrieval_text(); each query has a natural-language form and a topic-keyword form (the shape MIRIX topic extraction produces). 'unmatched' queries have no relevant skill.

skills.name: rotate-ssh-keys
triggers: an SSH key is old or may be compromised
a team member with server access leaves
skills.description: Generate a new ed25519 key pair, deploy the public key to every host, verify login, then remove the old key from authorized_keys.

skills.name: fix-failing-ci-build
triggers: the continuous integration pipeline turns red
tests pass locally but fail on the build server
skills.description: Reproduce the CI environment locally, compare dependency versions and environment variables, and bisect recent commits to find the change that broke the build.

skills.name: repot-houseplant
triggers: roots grow out of the drainage holes
a potted plant dries out within a day of watering
skills.description: Move the plant into a pot one size larger with fresh potting mix, loosen circling roots, water thoroughly and keep it out of direct sun for a week.

skills.name: adjust-bicycle-brakes
triggers: rim brakes squeal or feel spongy
the brake lever touches the handlebar
skills.description: Align the pads with the rim, tighten the cable at the barrel adjuster, and center the caliper so both pads contact the rim evenly.

skills.name: plan-multi-city-trip
triggers: someone wants to visit several cities in one journey
train and flight connections must be combined
skills.description: Order the cities to minimise backtracking, compare rail passes against point-to-point tickets, and leave buffer time between long connections.

skills.name: practice-scales-with-metronome
triggers: a musician wants cleaner fast passages
timing drifts when playing scales
skills.description: Start the metronome slow enough to play without mistakes, raise the tempo by small steps after three clean repetitions, and record progress.

skills.name: shoot-long-exposure-photo
triggers: photographing moving water or light trails
a night scene is too dark handheld
skills.description: Mount the camera on a tripod, use the lowest ISO, set a small aperture, use a remote shutter or timer, and add an ND filter in daylight.

skills.name: design-beginner-strength-program
triggers: a new lifter asks how to start weight training
someone wants a simple three-day gym plan
skills.description: Use compound lifts three times a week with linear progression, add weight each session while form holds, and deload after repeated stalls.

skills.name: spaced-repetition-vocabulary
triggers: learning words in a new language
forgetting flashcards after a few days
skills.description: Create cards with example sentences, review them on an increasing schedule, and suspend cards that are consistently easy.

skills.name: write-polite-follow-up-email
triggers: no reply to an important email after a week
need to nudge a colleague without sounding pushy
skills.description: Reference the original message, restate the single request, offer a concrete deadline or next step, and keep it under five sentences.

skills.name: debug-memory-leak-in-service
triggers: a long-running service's memory grows until it crashes
out-of-memory kills in production
skills.description: Capture heap snapshots at intervals, diff retained objects, look for unbounded caches or listeners, and confirm the fix with a soak test.

skills.name: brew-pour-over-coffee
triggers: making filter coffee by hand
coffee tastes sour or bitter
skills.description: Grind medium-fine, use a 1:16 coffee-to-water ratio, bloom for 30 seconds, pour in slow spirals, and adjust grind size to taste.

skills.name: set-up-database-backups
triggers: a production database has no backup policy
need point-in-time recovery
skills.description: Schedule nightly full dumps plus continuous write-ahead-log archiving, store copies off-site, and test a restore every month.

skills.name: prune-fruit-tree
triggers: an apple or pear tree has crowded branches
late winter orchard maintenance
skills.description: Remove dead, diseased and crossing branches first, open the center for light, and cut just above an outward-facing bud.

skills.name: patch-bicycle-inner-tube
triggers: a flat tire on a ride
slow air leak in a bike tube
skills.description: Find the puncture by inflating the tube near water, roughen the area, apply glue and a patch, and check the tire for the sharp object.

skills.name: resolve-git-merge-conflict
triggers: git reports conflicts during a merge or rebase
two branches edited the same lines
skills.description: Inspect both sides of each conflict hunk, keep the intended combination, run the tests, then mark files resolved and continue the rebase.

skills.name: train-puppy-to-sit
triggers: teaching a young dog basic commands
a puppy jumps on visitors
skills.description: Lure the puppy into a sit with a treat above its nose, mark the moment its rear touches the floor, reward, and fade the lure over a week.

skills.name: bake-sourdough-loaf
triggers: baking bread with a wild yeast starter
sourdough comes out dense
skills.description: Feed the starter until it doubles, autolyse the flour, perform stretch-and-folds during bulk fermentation, shape tightly, and proof cold overnight.

skills.name: configure-home-wifi-mesh
triggers: weak wifi signal in some rooms
adding extra access points at home
skills.description: Place the main node near the modem, space satellites within strong signal range, use wired backhaul if possible, and keep one network name.

skills.name: prepare-conference-talk
triggers: giving a presentation at a conference
slides feel overloaded
skills.description: Write the single takeaway first, build an outline around three points, limit each slide to one idea, and rehearse aloud with a timer.

skills.name: optimize-slow-sql-query
triggers: a query takes seconds instead of milliseconds
database CPU spikes on one endpoint
skills.description: Read the execution plan, add or adjust indexes on filter and join columns, avoid functions on indexed columns, and re-measure with realistic data.

skills.name: wax-cross-country-skis
triggers: skis feel slow or sticky on snow
preparing skis for a race
skills.description: Clean the base, choose glide wax for the snow temperature, iron it in evenly, let it cool, then scrape and brush the base.

skills.name: negotiate-salary-offer
triggers: received a job offer
want a higher starting salary
skills.description: Research the market range, express enthusiasm, anchor with a specific number backed by evidence, and negotiate total compensation not just base pay.

skills.name: set-up-python-virtualenv
triggers: package versions conflict between projects
starting a new Python project
skills.description: Create an isolated environment per project, pin dependencies in a lock file, and activate the environment before installing packages.

skills.name: clean-camera-sensor
triggers: dark spots appear in the same place on every photo
dust on the image sensor
skills.description: Use the camera's sensor-cleaning mode, try a blower first, then a sensor swab with cleaning fluid in one pass per side.

skills.name: treat-minor-burn
triggers: touched a hot pan
first-degree burn first aid
skills.description: Cool the burn under running cool water for twenty minutes, remove rings, cover loosely with a sterile dressing, and avoid ice or butter.

skills.name: tune-guitar-by-ear
triggers: guitar sounds out of tune without a tuner
strings drift during practice
skills.description: Tune the low E to a reference pitch, match each next string at the fifth fret (fourth fret for B), and check with harmonics.

skills.name: rollback-bad-deployment
triggers: error rate jumps right after a release
a new version breaks production
skills.description: Stop the rollout, redeploy the last known good version, confirm metrics recover, and open an incident review before retrying.

skills.name: plan-weekly-meal-prep
triggers: cooking for the whole week on Sunday
want to save time on weekday dinners
skills.description: Pick recipes that share ingredients, cook grains and proteins in bulk, portion into containers, and keep sauces separate until serving.

skills.name: write-unit-tests-for-legacy-code
triggers: changing old code without tests
afraid a refactor will break behavior
skills.description: Add characterization tests that capture current behavior, break dependencies with seams, then refactor in small steps while tests stay green.
